name: DashNotes – Modern Admin Notes
author: Nolan

sections.description:
DashNotes – Modern Admin Notes is a lightweight and easy-to-use plugin that allows WordPress users to create private notes directly in the admin dashboard.

Features:
* Add private quick notes for each user
* Save notes without page reload (AJAX)
* Each user’s notes are private
* Lightweight and fast

Future updates will include:
* Multiple notes per user
* Note titles
* Note colors and priority
* Auto-save
* Markdown support

DashNotes is perfect for bloggers, teams, and site owners who need a simple way to remember tasks, reminders, or ideas right in the dashboard.

Arbitrary section

If you like DashNotes, consider leaving a 5-star rating on WordPress.org!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dashnotes-quick-admin-notes folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to your dashboard; the “DashNotes ” widget will appear.
  4. Start writing notes and click Save. Your notes are saved per user.
sections.faq:
Are my notes private?

Yes, notes are saved for each individual user. No other users can see your notes.

Can I add multiple notes?

Yes, you can addd multiple notes.

Does it slow down my site?

No, DashNotes is lightweight and only runs on the admin dashboard.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes, since it only affects the WordPress admin dashboard.
